messages:
sam: FYI found a regression after the infra image bump — nvidia-driver 535.122 hits a kernel symbol mismatch on our ubuntu-20.04 node images :eyes:
anita: which CVE or vuln track is this tied to? or is it a compat bug?
sam: not a CVE yet, but there's an advisory referencing CVE-2026-0812 for 535.x that looks related. logs show module init failures. stacktrace pasted below.
sam: ```
[ 12.345678] nvidia: module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing - tainting kernel
[ 12.345679] nvidia 0000:01:00.0: failed to register device: -22
```
kevin: looks like the signed driver + KMS key rotation interaction we've seen. last time it was HSM signing mismatch.
jess: summary proposal: 1) triage CVE-2026-0812 (impact: driver load failure), 2) run downstream dependency matrix (CUDA/cuDNN/NCCL), 3) schedule canary patch rollout for Dedicated and Private first.
anita: agree. also block: RBAC: canary hosts need a temporary "gpu-canary" role so infra-oncall can SSH and collect debug. we should enable audit logging for those sessions.
sam: +1 — audit log retention for these debug sessions should be 90 days, tag entries with "gpu-rollout-1951" for traceability.
kevin: priority: P1 for Dedicated/Private customers (SLAs), P2 for hosted. We should avoid a global rollback if only a subset is affected.
jess: action items:
- sam: produce smoke test matrix for driver+cuda combo (commands + expected output)
- anita: verify KMS signing chain and test key rotation on staging HSM
- kevin: prepare canary RBAC role and policy, add audit export to splunk/secure-audit index
- deploy-bot: schedule canary window and attach alert hooks
sam: smoke test snippet: `dpkg -l | grep nvidia-driver && nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv`
anita: KMS check plan: rotate staging key (kms-staging-01), re-sign driver package, push to staging image build, run kernel module load tests. if signature mismatch persists we escalate to vendor.
kevin: RBAC snippet (IAM): `role/gpu_canary { members: [group:infra-oncall] permissions: [compute.instances.get, compute.ssh, logging.write] }` — audit logs on.
jess: timeline: triage today, prepare signed patch candidate tomorrow EOD, canary rollout Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC. if canary green for 4 hours promote.
sam: tests I want in matrix: module load, nvidia-smi, CUDA runtime sample `deviceQuery`, small NCCL ring test for inter-node comms.
anita: note: cuDNN and NCCL ABI mismatches sometimes manifest only with long sequences — add longer-run stress test in Dedicated canary (30m).
kevin: fallback policy: if driver fails during canary, auto-fallback to prev driver using rollback image and mark hosts as "gpu-failed-1951" in inventory.
jess: please add the verification checklist to the canary runbook, include steps to rotate KMS back if needed.
sam: ack — I'll drop logs into the thread and mark next steps. starting the packaging/signing now.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-start=1951286400 canary-end=1951308000 targets=dedicated-cpools,private-clusters alert=/#eng-oncall :bell:
kevin: pinging @security-leads to FYI. any compliance blockers for short-lived RBAC change?
anita: no blockers from compliance; ensure change audit + approval recorded in Jira (SEC-1951).
jess: thanks team. small ask: capture perf baseline before patch (token throughput per GPU) so we can spot regressions.
sam: will run baseline and attach numbers. back shortly.
kevin: acked :thumbsup:
